plugins.name: loopd
plugins.description: The OKF control panel as a Claude Code plugin — /dispatch, /new-project, /close-project, /init and /whats-up, then /answer, /welcome, /board, /fanout, /handoff and /prune-wt, plus the two PreToolUse enforcement hooks, the six role agents, the three review agents and three mods (usage, pane, signal) that are each a /config switch.

plugins.name: loopd-yolo
plugins.description: COMPANION to loopd. Ships AUTONOMY.md, the capability file that defines the `yolo` mode — the loop may promote fully-refined build drafts and merge on an independent clearance. Not installed = every project is gated. A companion ADDS behaviour and never removes a core gate.
